english: Point your phone at the meter. Mubazi reads the eight wheels for you, and you check them.
kinyarwanda: Erekeza telefoni kuri mubazi. Mubazi igusomera imibare umunani, nawe ukayigenzura.

english: Every reading is compared with your own usual use, and a WASAC officer looks at anything unusual.
kinyarwanda: Buri gipimo kigereranywa n'ibyo usanzwe ukoresha, kandi umukozi wa WASAC agenzura ikidasanzwe.

english: Approve the bill with your MTN Mobile Money PIN. The receipt comes by SMS.
kinyarwanda: Emeza fagitire ukoresheje umubare w'ibanga wa MTN Mobile Money. Inyemezabwishyu iza kuri SMS.
Ikora kuri telefoni iyo ari yo yose

english: No smartphone? Dial the USSD menu to send a reading, see your bill or pay.
kinyarwanda: Nta telefoni igezweho? Kanda menu ya USSD wohereze igipimo, urebe fagitire cyangwa wishyure.

english: When your use jumps, we tell you what to check, so a leak is found early.
kinyarwanda: Iyo ukoresha amazi menshi bitunguranye, tukubwira icyo ugenzura, kugira ngo amazi ameneka aboneke kare.

english: Every screen in Kinyarwanda and English.
kinyarwanda: Buri paji mu Kinyarwanda no mu Cyongereza.

english: Every bill, and how much water you used each month.
kinyarwanda: Buri fagitire, n'amazi wakoresheje buri kwezi.

english: A code by SMS. No password to remember.
kinyarwanda: Kode kuri SMS. Nta jambo ry'ibanga ryo kwibuka.

english: It takes about a minute, and you see your bill straight away.
kinyarwanda: Bifata nk'umunota umwe, kandi uhita ubona fagitire yawe.

english: Water billing for WASAC customers in Rwanda: read the meter, check the bill, pay.
kinyarwanda: Fagitire y'amazi ku bafatabuguzi ba WASAC mu Rwanda: soma mubazi, genzura fagitire, wishyure.
